text.description_html:
FAL-19-V-EO-689, Surface Vertical Rod Panic Device for Narrow Stile Doors

This touch bar style exit device is suitable for wood, hollow metal or Aluminum Narrow Stile Doors that are 1-3/4” thick. Meets ANSI grade 1 requirements. The Narrow Stile Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device comes with deadlocking top latch retention and square bolt at bottom and is UL listed for B label fire door installations.

Features of the Falcon 19-V-EO-SP28 Narrow Stile Storefront Door Surface Vertical Rod:

  • ANSI Grade 1 rating
  • Listed by UL / ULC for ratings of "B" Label (1-1/2 hours).
  • Comes packaged with all mounting hardware.

Specifications of the Storefront Door Surface Vertical Rod:

  • Finish: powder-coated Aluminum
  • Projection: 2-1/2” max., 1-7/8” dogged
  • Stile: Minimum Stile 1-3/4” fits doors up to 34" wide. For doors with minimum stiles of 2-1/4", fits doors up to 36" wide.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4” thick
  • Door Height: Up to 7 ft (field sizeable)
  • Top Latch: stainless steel 3/4” throw
  • Bottom Latch: square bolt 1/2” throw
  • Dogging: 1/2" turn hex key in touch bar
  • Devices are handed but field reversible

Sold Individually. Packaged as Exit Device Only - No Trim.
